monitoring.explain: As of {asOf}. A loan counts as bad when it reached {dpd}+ days past due within {months} months of disbursement; only loans disbursed at least that long ago (mature) count towards bad rates, Gini, AUC and KS. Stability compares the grade mix of applications scored {baselineFrom} – {baselineTo} (baseline) with {recentFrom} – {recentTo} (recent). Challenger rows are shadow evaluations: they are scored alongside the champion but never affect a decision, so their approval figures reflect the champion’s decisions.

WAIVE.label: Waive
WAIVE.summary: Interest arising during the holiday is waived; the borrower pays nothing for it. The lender bears the cost.

DEFER_NO_CAPITALIZATION.label: Defer, no capitalization
DEFER_NO_CAPITALIZATION.summary: Interest becomes payable later without bearing further interest.

PAY_SEPARATELY.label: Pay separately
PAY_SEPARATELY.summary: Interest remains payable during the holiday; only principal is deferred.

CAPITALIZE.label: Capitalize
CAPITALIZE.summary: Interest is added to the principal and bears interest from then on, so the holiday increases what is owed.

EXTEND_TERM.label: Extend term
EXTEND_TERM.summary: The skipped payments are added to the end: the loan matures as many periods later.

KEEP_MATURITY.label: Keep maturity
KEEP_MATURITY.summary: The maturity date holds; the skipped payments are absorbed into higher instalments afterwards — relief now, a heavier burden later.
